correctness.rationale: For integer b>=2 including composite b, y_b(bu)=1-y_b(u) and y_b(t)=0 when b does not divide t. Longest zero run has 2b-1 symbols and gives unique terminal maximal zero palindrome 0^(2b-2), with two starts per valuation-even center. Every palindrome containing a 1 has a reflection axis on the b-lattice, and language-maximality forces external multiple-of-b positions; it uniquely descends via the complemented 0^(b-1)-padded inflation map F_b. Conversely the lift preserves nonextendibility and shifts all starts by a factor b. Induction yields lengths (2b-1)b^k-1, exact position formula and density 2/[b^(k+1)(b+1)] via valuation parity frequencies. Independent factor and occurrence prefix checks passed for bases 2..7, n up to 80.
